Wound scanning app helping to ‘save nurse time’
items.summary: A wound-scanning app used by district nursing teams in Wales has helped save nurse time and improve patient care. The ‘Minuteful for Wound’ app, developed by technology company Precision Health Tech, allows nurses and healthcare staff to scan and measure wounds so they can be monitored virtually.

items.title: Vacuum-assisted closure therapy in the management of patients with necrotising fasciitis
items.summary: Objective: This study aims to compare vacuum-assisted closure (VAC) and conventional wound dressings in patients with necrotising fasciitis (NF).

items.title: Rare aetiologies of leg ulcers: a prospective analysis
items.summary: Objective: As treatment guidelines differ based on the causal effects of hard-to-heal (chronic) leg ulcers, correct diagnosis is essential for the best therapeutic outcomes.

items.title: Intermittent pneumatic thigh compression for the treatment of lower limb wounds (IPCOTT): a randomised control trial
items.summary: Objective: Hard-to-heal (chronic) venous leg ulcers (VLUs) are challenging to heal with standard of care (SoC) alone.

items.title: Biomechanical influence of cavity fillers on periwound soft tissue strains in sacral pressure injuries
items.summary: Objective: Deep cavity pressure injuries (PIs) are commonly managed with wound fillers, the biomechanical role of which remains poorly understood. This study aimed to assess how the mechanical properties of filler influence periwound soft tissue strains.

items.title: Safety and cost-effectiveness of a pure hypochlorous acid cleansing solution in wounds and non-intact skin management: a narrative review
items.summary: Objective: Wound cleansing is an essential part of wound bed preparation and its importance in wound management is supported by numerous international guidelines and consensus documents. Cleansing solutions are used by healthcare professionals for wounds and non-intact skin.
